entries.example: 地板擦得好乾淨，都發亮了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The floor has been cleaned so well that it shines.
entries.question: 你看過會發亮的螢火蟲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen fireflies glowing?
entries.answer: 看過，螢火蟲在山上一閃一閃地發亮。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen fireflies twinkling and glowing in the mountains.

entries.example: 我女兒每週學一次鋼琴。
entries.exampleEnglish: My daughter has a piano lesson once a week.
entries.question: 你會彈鋼琴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you play the piano?
entries.answer: 我會彈一點鋼琴。
entries.answerEnglish: I can play the piano a little.

entries.example: 他戴那頂帽子看起來好滑稽。
entries.exampleEnglish: He looks so silly in that hat.
entries.question: 你看過什麼滑稽的表演？
entries.questionEnglish: What funny performances have you seen?
entries.answer: 我在西門町看過很滑稽的街頭表演。
entries.answerEnglish: I once saw a really comical street performance in Ximending.

entries.example: 我用烤箱烤了一個蛋糕。
entries.exampleEnglish: I baked a cake in the oven.
entries.question: 你家有烤箱嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have an oven at home?
entries.answer: 有，我常用烤箱烤麵包。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often bake bread in the oven.

entries.exampleEnglish: I only had a salad for lunch.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃沙拉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like salad?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常吃雞肉沙拉。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often eat chicken salad.

entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of sheep at Cingjing Farm.
entries.question: 你摸過羊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever touched a sheep?
entries.answer: 摸過，我在農場摸過羊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I touched one at a farm.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm so hungry. Let's go eat!
entries.question: 你現在餓不餓？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you hungry right now?
entries.answer: 我有一點餓。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a little hungry.

entries.exampleEnglish: My grandpa is eighty this year.
entries.question: 你常常去看爺爺嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often visit your grandpa?
entries.answer: 我每個月去看爺爺一次。
entries.answerEnglish: I visit my grandpa once a month.

entries.exampleEnglish: Sorry to interrupt.
entries.question: 別人說話時，你會打斷嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you interrupt when other people are talking?
entries.answer: 不會，我不喜歡打斷別人說話。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't like interrupting people.

entries.example: 我考過華語考試，拿到一張證書。
entries.exampleEnglish: I passed the Chinese test and got a certificate.
entries.question: 你有什麼證書？
entries.questionEnglish: What certificates do you have?
entries.answer: 我有一張潛水證書。
entries.answerEnglish: I have a diving certificate.

entries.example: 這間房間只有淋浴，沒有浴缸。
entries.exampleEnglish: This room only has a shower, no bathtub.
entries.question: 你喜歡淋浴還是泡澡？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer showers or baths?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡淋浴，比較快。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer showers; they're quicker.

entries.example: 這棟大樓的外部正在整修。
entries.exampleEnglish: The outside of this building is being renovated.
entries.question: 你們公司會找外部的人幫忙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company bring in outside help?
entries.answer: 會，我們的網站是外部的公司做的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, our website was made by an outside company.

entries.exampleEnglish: The bank clerk is very patient.
entries.question: 你們公司有多少職員？
entries.questionEnglish: How many staff does your company have?
entries.answer: 我們公司有五十個職員。
entries.answerEnglish: Our company has fifty staff.

entries.exampleEnglish: Swallow this pill with water.
entries.question: 吃藥時，你可以一次吞下很多顆嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you take medicine, can you swallow several pills at once?
entries.answer: 不行，我一次只能吞下一顆。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I can only swallow one at a time.

entries.example: 請先到一樓的接待處登記。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please check in at reception on the first floor first.
entries.question: 你們公司的接待處在幾樓？
entries.questionEnglish: Which floor is your company's reception on?
entries.answer: 我們公司的接待處在一樓。
entries.answerEnglish: Our company's reception is on the first floor.

entries.example: 夏天的山上有很多昆蟲。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of insects in the mountains in summer.
entries.question: 你最怕什麼昆蟲？
entries.questionEnglish: Which insect are you most afraid of?
entries.answer: 我最怕蟑螂這種昆蟲。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm most afraid of cockroaches.

entries.example: 他每個週末都去練習射擊。
entries.exampleEnglish: He goes to practice shooting every weekend.
entries.question: 你玩過射擊遊戲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever played shooting games?
entries.answer: 玩過，我很喜歡玩射擊遊戲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really like shooting games.

entries.exampleEnglish: She is a famous painter.
entries.question: 你喜歡哪一位畫家？
entries.questionEnglish: Which painter do you like?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡的畫家是梵谷。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite painter is Van Gogh.

entries.english: break down; be out of order
entries.example: 捷運故障了，我上班遲到了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The MRT broke down, so I was late for work.
entries.question: 你的手機故障過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your phone ever broken down?
entries.answer: 有，上個月我的手機故障了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my phone stopped working last month.

entries.exampleEnglish: This kind of fabric feels really nice.
entries.question: 你去買菜會帶布袋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take a cloth bag when you go grocery shopping?
entries.answer: 會，我都用布袋裝菜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always carry my groceries in a cloth bag.

entries.exampleEnglish: Jiufen is a very popular tourist attraction.
entries.question: 你最喜歡台灣哪個景點？
entries.questionEnglish: Which attraction in Taiwan do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡日月潭這個景點。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite is Sun Moon Lake.

entries.exampleEnglish: We pitched a tent by the sea.
entries.question: 你睡過帳篷嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever slept in a tent?
entries.answer: 睡過，去露營的時候睡帳篷。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I slept in a tent when I went camping.

entries.exampleEnglish: Smoking is bad for your lungs.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的空氣對肺好嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taipei's air is good for your lungs?
entries.answer: 不太好，空氣不好會傷肺。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. Bad air hurts your lungs.

entries.example: 小心，這把刀的刀刃很利。
entries.exampleEnglish: Careful, the blade of this knife is very sharp.
entries.question: 你家菜刀的刀刃還利嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is the blade of your kitchen knife still sharp?
entries.answer: 不太利了，刀刃有點鈍。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really, the blade is a bit dull.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like a bowl of soup.
entries.question: 你喜歡喝什麼湯？
entries.questionEnglish: What soup do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡喝玉米湯。
entries.answerEnglish: I like corn soup.

entries.example: 你知道誰發明了電話嗎？
entries.exampleEnglish: Do you know who invented the telephone?
entries.question: 你覺得最棒的發明是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is the best invention?
entries.answer: 我覺得手機是最棒的發明。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the mobile phone is the best invention.

entries.example: 夏天用電多，電力常常不夠。
entries.exampleEnglish: People use a lot of electricity in summer, so power often runs short.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣夏天的電力夠用嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan has enough electric power in summer?
entries.answer: 我覺得夏天的電力有點不夠。
entries.answerEnglish: I think power is a bit short in summer.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm sorry, please forgive me.
entries.question: 朋友對你說謊，你會原諒他嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: If a friend lied to you, would you forgive them?
entries.answer: 看情況，我可能會原諒他。
entries.answerEnglish: It depends. I might forgive them.

entries.example: 捷運每班車大約間隔五分鐘。
entries.exampleEnglish: MRT trains come about every five minutes.
entries.question: 你家附近的公車間隔多久？
entries.questionEnglish: How far apart are the buses near your home?
entries.answer: 大概間隔十五分鐘一班。
entries.answerEnglish: There's one about every fifteen minutes.

entries.example: 這幅畫現在在故宮展出。
entries.exampleEnglish: This painting is on display at the National Palace Museum now.
entries.question: 你想看故宮展出的什麼東西？
entries.questionEnglish: What would you like to see on display at the National Palace Museum?
entries.answer: 我想看故宮展出的翠玉白菜。
entries.answerEnglish: I want to see the Jadeite Cabbage on display there.

entries.example: 我需要一根針和一些線。
entries.exampleEnglish: I need a needle and some thread.
entries.question: 你怕打針嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of injections?
entries.answer: 我很怕打針。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm really scared of injections.

entries.exampleEnglish: My younger brother studies physics at university.
entries.question: 你以前喜歡上物理課嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you use to like physics class?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我覺得物理很難。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I found physics hard.

entries.example: 這件襯衫是絲做的，要手洗。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shirt is made of silk, so it has to be hand-washed.
entries.question: 你有絲做的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any clothes made of silk?
entries.answer: 有，我有一條絲做的領帶。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a silk tie.

entries.example: 牆上有一根釘子，可以掛畫。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a nail in the wall for hanging a picture.
entries.question: 你會自己在牆上釘釘子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put nails in the wall yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我常自己釘釘子掛照片。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often hammer in nails myself to hang photos.

entries.exampleEnglish: After the rain, the road is all mud.
entries.question: 你小時候玩過泥巴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you play in the mud as a child?
entries.answer: 玩過，我小時候常常玩泥巴。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often played in the mud as a kid.

entries.example: 這家咖啡店的裝潢很有藝術感。
entries.exampleEnglish: This café's decor is really artistic.
entries.question: 你覺得台北哪裡很有藝術感？
entries.questionEnglish: Where in Taipei feels really artistic to you?
entries.answer: 我覺得華山文創園區很有藝術感。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Huashan Creative Park is very artistic.

entries.example: 我每天早上吃一些堅果。
entries.exampleEnglish: I eat some nuts every morning.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃堅果嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like nuts?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常把堅果當點心。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often snack on nuts.

entries.exampleEnglish: In winter you should wear gloves when riding a scooter.
entries.question: 你冬天會戴手套嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear gloves in winter?
entries.answer: 騎機車的時候我會戴手套。
entries.answerEnglish: I wear gloves when I ride my scooter.

entries.example: 我的腳趾踢到桌子，好痛！
entries.exampleEnglish: I stubbed my toe on the table. It hurts!
entries.question: 你的腳趾受過傷嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever hurt your toe?
entries.answer: 有，我踢到桌腳，腳趾腫了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I kicked a table leg and my toe swelled up.

entries.exampleEnglish: He hesitated for a long time before deciding.
entries.question: 買東西時，你常常猶豫嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often hesitate when shopping?
entries.answer: 會，我買衣服常常猶豫很久。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often hesitate for ages when buying clothes.

entries.example: 她今天穿一條白色的裙子。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's wearing a white skirt today.
entries.question: 你喜歡穿裙子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing skirts?
entries.answer: 喜歡，夏天我常常穿裙子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often wear skirts in summer.

entries.example: 請幫我寫這份報告的摘要。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please write a summary of this report for me.
entries.question: 你工作時常常要寫摘要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often have to write summaries at work?
entries.answer: 會，我每週都要寫會議摘要。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to write meeting summaries every week.

entries.exampleEnglish: This is my girlfriend.
entries.question: 你有女朋友嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a girlfriend?
entries.answer: 有，我女朋友是台灣人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my girlfriend is Taiwanese.

entries.exampleEnglish: This packet of powdered medicine should be taken with water.
entries.question: 你煮菜時常加胡椒粉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often add pepper when you cook?
entries.answer: 會，我煮湯常加一點胡椒粉。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often add a little pepper to soup.

entries.exampleEnglish: It's too dark. Please turn on the light for me.
entries.question: 你睡覺時會開燈嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you leave the light on when you sleep?
entries.answer: 不會，我睡覺時都關燈。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I always turn the light off when I sleep.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please put the leftovers in a container.
entries.question: 你買外帶時會自己帶容器嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you bring your own container when you buy takeout?
entries.answer: 會，我買豆花會帶自己的容器。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bring my own container when I buy douhua.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like a lemon green tea.
entries.question: 你喝水會加檸檬嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put lemon in your water?
entries.answer: 會，我喜歡在水裡加檸檬。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like adding lemon to my water.

entries.exampleEnglish: My office is upstairs.
entries.question: 你家樓上住了什麼人？
entries.questionEnglish: Who lives upstairs from you?
entries.answer: 我家樓上住一對老夫妻。
entries.answerEnglish: An elderly couple lives upstairs from me.

entries.exampleEnglish: This piece of clothing is so ugly.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼顏色的衣服很難看？
entries.questionEnglish: What color of clothing do you think looks ugly?
entries.answer: 我覺得咖啡色的衣服很難看。
entries.answerEnglish: I think brown clothes look ugly.

entries.example: 這些花是人造的，不是真的。
entries.exampleEnglish: These flowers are artificial, not real.
entries.question: 你喜歡人造花還是真花？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer artificial flowers or real ones?
entries.answer: 我喜歡真花，人造花不夠漂亮。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer real flowers; artificial ones aren't pretty enough.

entries.exampleEnglish: I fell and hurt my elbow.
entries.question: 你的手肘受過傷嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever hurt your elbow?
entries.answer: 有，打籃球時手肘受過傷。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I hurt my elbow playing basketball.

entries.example: 你有資格參加這個比賽。
entries.exampleEnglish: You're eligible to enter this competition.
entries.question: 你覺得你有資格教什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think you're qualified to teach?
entries.answer: 我覺得我有資格教英文。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm qualified to teach English.

entries.exampleEnglish: Excuse me, where's the restroom?
entries.question: 你家有幾間廁所？
entries.questionEnglish: How many bathrooms are there in your home?
entries.answer: 我家有兩間廁所。
entries.answerEnglish: There are two bathrooms in my home.

entries.example: 這個杯子的花紋很細緻。
entries.exampleEnglish: The pattern on this cup is very delicate.
entries.question: 你覺得哪裡的手工藝很細緻？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think the handicrafts are very fine?
entries.answer: 我覺得鶯歌的陶瓷很細緻。
entries.answerEnglish: I think the pottery from Yingge is very fine.

entries.example: 這只是一場非正式的會議。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is just an informal meeting.
entries.question: 你喜歡正式還是非正式的聚會？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer formal or informal gatherings?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡非正式的聚會。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer informal gatherings.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please put the letter in the envelope.
entries.question: 你還會用信封寄信嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still send letters in envelopes?
entries.answer: 很少，我只用信封寄卡片。
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. I only use envelopes to send cards.

entries.exampleEnglish: I want to eat beef noodles.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃牛肉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like beef?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最喜歡牛肉麵。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love beef noodles most.

entries.example: 這部電影的特效很逼真。
entries.exampleEnglish: The special effects in this movie are very realistic.
entries.question: 你看過很逼真的蠟像嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen very lifelike wax figures?
entries.answer: 看過，那些蠟像做得好逼真。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, those wax figures were so lifelike.

entries.exampleEnglish: The child is sucking juice through a straw.
entries.question: 你喝珍奶會用吸管嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you use a straw when you drink bubble tea?
entries.answer: 會，我用粗吸管吸珍珠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I suck up the pearls with a thick straw.

entries.exampleEnglish: This rule is absolutely ridiculous!
entries.question: 你聽過什麼荒謬的規定？
entries.questionEnglish: What ridiculous rules have you heard of?
entries.answer: 我聽過上班不能喝水這種荒謬的規定。
entries.answerEnglish: I've heard of an absurd rule that you can't drink water at work.

entries.example: 我學中文純粹是因為興趣。
entries.exampleEnglish: I study Chinese purely out of interest.
entries.question: 你來台灣純粹是為了工作嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you come to Taiwan purely for work?
entries.answer: 不是純粹為了工作，我也很喜歡台灣。
entries.answerEnglish: Not purely for work. I also really like Taiwan.

entries.example: 天氣太熱，冰淇淋都融化了。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's so hot that the ice cream has melted.
entries.question: 台灣的夏天會讓你熱到快融化嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does Taiwan's summer make you feel like you're melting?
entries.answer: 會，夏天熱到我快融化了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the summer is so hot I'm almost melting.

entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of minerals in this mountain.
entries.question: 你覺得喝什麼水比較健康？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of water do you think is healthier?
entries.answer: 我覺得有礦物質的水比較健康。
entries.answerEnglish: I think water with minerals in it is healthier.

entries.example: 現在很少人用光碟看電影了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Few people watch movies on discs these days.
entries.question: 你家還有光碟嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you still have any discs at home?
entries.answer: 有，我還留著幾張音樂光碟。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've still got a few music CDs.

entries.example: 這條山路很陡，要小心走。
entries.exampleEnglish: This mountain path is steep, so walk carefully.
entries.question: 你爬過很陡的山嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever climbed a very steep mountain?
entries.answer: 爬過，象山的樓梯很陡。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the steps up Elephant Mountain are very steep.

entries.exampleEnglish: He got drunk last night.
entries.question: 你喝醉過嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been drunk?
entries.answer: 喝醉過一次，隔天頭很痛。
entries.answerEnglish: Once, and I had a terrible headache the next day.

entries.example: 我買了一條新的牛仔褲。
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a new pair of jeans.
entries.question: 你常常穿牛仔褲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often wear jeans?
entries.answer: 對，我上班也穿牛仔褲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I even wear jeans to work.

entries.exampleEnglish: There's a faint scent of flowers in the room.
entries.question: 你喜歡淡淡的香水味嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like a light perfume scent?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡淡淡的味道。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like subtle scents.

entries.example: 我不確定他明天會不會來。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm not sure whether he'll come tomorrow.
entries.question: 你下個月還會在台灣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Will you still be in Taiwan next month?
entries.answer: 我還不確定。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm not sure yet.

entries.exampleEnglish: I've typed so much that my wrist aches.
entries.question: 你的手腕會痠痛嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your wrist ever ache?
entries.answer: 會，用電腦太久手腕就會痠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my wrist aches if I use the computer too long.

entries.exampleEnglish: She speaks English with a British accent.
entries.question: 你說中文有口音嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have an accent when you speak Chinese?
entries.answer: 有，我說中文有一點美國口音。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a slight American accent when I speak Chinese.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm not very good at math.
entries.question: 你喜歡數學嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like math?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我的數學很差。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm bad at math.

entries.exampleEnglish: This rule really confuses me.
entries.question: 學中文時，什麼讓你最困惑？
entries.questionEnglish: What confuses you most when learning Chinese?
entries.answer: 聲調最讓我困惑。
entries.answerEnglish: The tones confuse me the most.

entries.exampleEnglish: I bought two cans of beer.
entries.question: 你一天喝幾罐飲料？
entries.questionEnglish: How many cans of drinks do you have a day?
entries.answer: 我一天喝一罐咖啡。
entries.answerEnglish: I drink one can of coffee a day.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please sign here.
entries.question: 你有名人的簽名嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a celebrity's autograph?
entries.answer: 有，我有一位歌手的簽名。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a singer's autograph.

entries.example: 她的戒指上有一顆鑽石。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a diamond on her ring.
entries.question: 你覺得結婚一定要買鑽石嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have to buy a diamond to get married?
entries.answer: 不一定，我覺得鑽石太貴了。
entries.answerEnglish: Not necessarily. I think diamonds are too expensive.

entries.exampleEnglish: There's a bird's nest in the tree.
entries.question: 你家附近有鳥巢嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any birds' nests near your home?
entries.answer: 有，我家陽台上有一個鳥巢。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a bird's nest on my balcony.

entries.exampleEnglish: That dancer dances beautifully.
entries.question: 你喜歡看舞者表演嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching dancers perform?
entries.answer: 喜歡，舞者的動作都很美。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, dancers' movements are all so beautiful.

entries.example: 這家公司對時間很嚴格。
entries.exampleEnglish: This company is very strict about time.
entries.question: 你的老闆很嚴格嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your boss strict?
entries.answer: 還好，我的老闆不太嚴格。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really, my boss isn't very strict.

entries.exampleEnglish: There are snakes in the mountains, so be careful.
entries.question: 你怕蛇嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of snakes?
entries.answer: 我很怕蛇。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm really afraid of snakes.

entries.exampleEnglish: Southern Taiwan has a tropical climate.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪種熱帶水果？
entries.questionEnglish: Which tropical fruit do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡芒果這種熱帶水果。
entries.answerEnglish: Mango is my favorite tropical fruit.

entries.example: 他對我比了一個大拇指。
entries.exampleEnglish: He gave me a thumbs-up.
entries.question: 你常對朋友比大拇指嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often give your friends a thumbs-up?
entries.answer: 會，我常比大拇指說「讚」。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often give a thumbs-up to say "great".

entries.exampleEnglish: He has a bit of stubble on his chin.
entries.question: 你想事情時會摸下巴嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you touch your chin when you're thinking?
entries.answer: 會，我想事情時常摸下巴。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often touch my chin when I'm thinking.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please insert your credit card into the machine.
entries.question: 你會在簡報裡插入照片嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you insert photos into your presentations?
entries.answer: 會，我常在簡報裡插入照片。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often insert photos into my slides.

entries.exampleEnglish: You need flour and sugar to make cookies.
entries.question: 你會用麵粉做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you make with flour?
entries.answer: 我會用麵粉做蔥油餅。
entries.answerEnglish: I make scallion pancakes with flour.

entries.exampleEnglish: Don't forget a towel when you go swimming.
entries.question: 你運動時會帶毛巾嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you bring a towel when you exercise?
entries.answer: 會，我都帶一條小毛巾。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always bring a small towel.

entries.example: 每個人選工作的標準都不一樣。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone has different criteria for choosing a job.
entries.question: 你選房子的標準是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What are your criteria for choosing a place to live?
entries.answer: 我的標準是離捷運站近。
entries.answerEnglish: My criterion is being close to an MRT station.

entries.exampleEnglish: After retiring, he went back to the countryside to farm.
entries.question: 你想過退休後去種田嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever thought of farming after you retire?
entries.answer: 想過，我想退休後去花蓮種田。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'd like to farm in Hualien after I retire.

entries.example: 朋友的話讓我覺得很溫暖。
entries.exampleEnglish: My friend's words made me feel warm inside.
entries.question: 在台灣，什麼事讓你覺得溫暖？
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, what makes you feel warm inside?
entries.answer: 鄰居送我水果，讓我覺得很溫暖。
entries.answerEnglish: My neighbor gave me fruit, and it made me feel warm inside.

entries.exampleEnglish: He's been out of work for three months.
entries.question: 如果失業了，你會做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: If you lost your job, what would you do?
entries.answer: 如果失業了，我會先去旅行。
entries.answerEnglish: If I lost my job, I'd go traveling first.

entries.example: 公園裡有一座很大的雕像。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a big statue in the park.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過什麼雕像？
entries.questionEnglish: What statues have you seen in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 我在朱銘美術館看過很多雕像。
entries.answerEnglish: I saw lots of statues at the Juming Museum.

entries.example: 我姊姊在一家化學公司上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: My older sister works at a chemical company.
entries.question: 你以前喜歡上化學課嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you use to like chemistry class?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我覺得化學實驗很好玩。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I thought chemistry experiments were fun.

entries.example: 這本書的中文翻譯很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: The Chinese translation of this book is very good.
entries.question: 你看不懂中文時，會請人翻譯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you can't read something in Chinese, do you ask someone to translate?
entries.answer: 會，我常請同事幫我翻譯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often ask a coworker to translate for me.

entries.exampleEnglish: The breakup made him miserable.
entries.question: 你覺得學中文痛苦嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find learning Chinese painful?
entries.answer: 有時候背單字很痛苦。
entries.answerEnglish: Memorizing vocabulary is painful sometimes.

entries.exampleEnglish: Let's take a taxi there.
entries.question: 你常坐計程車嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often take taxis?
entries.answer: 很少，計程車太貴了。
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. Taxis are too expensive.

entries.exampleEnglish: These two roads are perpendicular to each other.
entries.question: 你住的地方，路是互相垂直的嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Where you live, are the roads at right angles to each other?
entries.answer: 對，我家附近的路大多互相垂直。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, most of the roads near my home are at right angles.

entries.example: 開會遲到的人要接受懲罰。
entries.exampleEnglish: Anyone late for the meeting has to take a penalty.
entries.question: 小孩做錯事，你覺得應該懲罰嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When kids do something wrong, do you think they should be punished?
entries.answer: 應該，但懲罰不能太重。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but the punishment shouldn't be too harsh.

entries.example: 這裡的水很淺，小孩可以玩。
entries.exampleEnglish: The water here is shallow, so kids can play.
entries.question: 你喜歡在水淺的地方游泳嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like swimming where the water is shallow?
entries.answer: 對，我只敢在水淺的地方游泳。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I only dare to swim where the water is shallow.

entries.example: 他在工廠負責修理機械。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's in charge of repairing machinery at the factory.
entries.question: 你對機械有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in machines?
entries.answer: 有，我大學念的是機械工程。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I studied mechanical engineering at university.

entries.exampleEnglish: The printer is out of paper again.
entries.question: 你家有印表機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a printer at home?
entries.answer: 有，我家有一台小印表機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a small printer at home.

entries.exampleEnglish: The keys are in the second drawer.
entries.question: 你辦公桌的抽屜裡放什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you keep in your desk drawer?
entries.answer: 我的抽屜裡放了很多零食。
entries.answerEnglish: I keep lots of snacks in my drawer.

entries.example: 糖在熱水裡溶解得很快。
entries.exampleEnglish: Sugar dissolves quickly in hot water.
entries.question: 你泡咖啡會等糖溶解嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you make coffee, do you wait for the sugar to dissolve?
entries.answer: 會，我會攪一攪，讓糖溶解。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I stir it so the sugar dissolves.

entries.example: 天氣好熱，我流了很多汗。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's so hot that I'm sweating a lot.
entries.question: 台灣的夏天你常流汗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you sweat a lot in Taiwan's summer?
entries.answer: 常常，我走一下路就滿身大汗。
entries.answerEnglish: All the time. I'm drenched in sweat after a short walk.

entries.example: 週末我喜歡去戶外走走。
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I like to go outdoors for a walk.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼戶外活動？
entries.questionEnglish: What outdoor activities do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡爬山和騎腳踏車這些戶外活動。
entries.answerEnglish: I like outdoor activities like hiking and cycling.

entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant really disappointed me.
entries.question: 最近有什麼事讓你很失望？
entries.questionEnglish: Has anything disappointed you lately?
entries.answer: 下雨不能去海邊，我很失望。
entries.answerEnglish: I was disappointed that the rain stopped us from going to the beach.

entries.example: 爺爺的耳朵有點聾，要大聲說話。
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandpa is a bit deaf, so you need to speak loudly.
entries.question: 你會把音樂開得很大聲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you play your music really loud?
entries.answer: 不會，我怕耳朵會聾。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm afraid I'd go deaf.

entries.exampleEnglish: Wash your hands with soap before eating.
entries.question: 你喜歡用肥皂還是沐浴乳？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you prefer bar soap or body wash?
entries.answer: 我比較喜歡用肥皂。
entries.answerEnglish: I prefer bar soap.

entries.example: 地圖上的紅點就是我們這裡。
entries.exampleEnglish: The red dot on the map is where we are.
entries.question: 你喜歡有點點的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like polka-dot clothes?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我有一件點點的洋裝。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a polka-dot dress.

entries.exampleEnglish: After moving things, my lower back really hurts.
entries.question: 你坐太久會腰痠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your back ache if you sit too long?
entries.answer: 會，我坐太久腰就很痠。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my lower back aches if I sit too long.

entries.example: 住在捷運站旁邊很方便。
entries.exampleEnglish: Living next to an MRT station is very convenient.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的生活方便嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find life in Taiwan convenient?
entries.answer: 很方便，到處都有便利商店。
entries.answerEnglish: Very convenient. There are convenience stores everywhere.

entries.example: 搭飛機不能帶太多液體。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't take too much liquid on a plane.
entries.question: 你搭飛機時會帶液體嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take liquids with you when you fly?
entries.answer: 不會，我把液體都放在行李箱。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I put all liquids in my suitcase.

entries.exampleEnglish: He's very skilled with chopsticks.
entries.question: 你用筷子用得熟練嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you good at using chopsticks?
entries.answer: 還算熟練，我每天都用筷子吃飯。
entries.answerEnglish: Pretty good. I eat with chopsticks every day.

entries.example: 這家店很神祕，沒有招牌。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop is mysterious; it has no sign.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣哪個地方很神祕？
entries.questionEnglish: Which place in Taiwan do you find mysterious?
entries.answer: 我覺得晚上的九份很神祕。
entries.answerEnglish: I find Jiufen at night very mysterious.

entries.example: 這件襯衫的袖子太長了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The sleeves of this shirt are too long.
entries.question: 夏天你喜歡穿有袖子的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: In summer, do you like wearing clothes with sleeves?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，夏天我都穿沒有袖子的衣服。
entries.answerEnglish: No, in summer I always wear sleeveless clothes.

entries.exampleEnglish: This ad is really funny.
entries.question: 你看影片時會跳過廣告嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you skip ads when you watch videos?
entries.answer: 會，我都馬上跳過廣告。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always skip the ads right away.

entries.exampleEnglish: Could I have a fork, please?
entries.question: 你吃麵用筷子還是叉子？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat noodles with chopsticks or a fork?
entries.answer: 我吃義大利麵用叉子。
entries.answerEnglish: I use a fork for spaghetti.

entries.example: 工作一直出錯，讓他很沮喪。
entries.exampleEnglish: Making mistakes at work again and again got him down.
entries.question: 你沮喪的時候會做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you feel down?
entries.answer: 我沮喪的時候會去跑步。
entries.answerEnglish: When I feel down, I go for a run.

entries.exampleEnglish: I go to the supermarket for groceries after work.
entries.question: 你常去哪家超市？
entries.questionEnglish: Which supermarket do you usually go to?
entries.answer: 我常去家附近的那家超市。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually go to the supermarket near my home.

entries.exampleEnglish: Her umbrella is purple.
entries.question: 你喜歡紫色嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like purple?
entries.answer: 喜歡，紫色是我最喜歡的顏色。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, purple is my favorite color.

entries.exampleEnglish: I always wear long pants in winter.
entries.question: 你上班要穿長褲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to wear long pants to work?
entries.answer: 要，我上班都穿長褲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always wear long pants to work.

entries.example: 這把刀太鈍了，切不動肉。
entries.exampleEnglish: This knife is too blunt to cut the meat.
entries.question: 你家的剪刀很鈍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are the scissors at your home blunt?
entries.answer: 有一點鈍，該換新的了。
entries.answerEnglish: A bit blunt. It's time to get new ones.

entries.exampleEnglish: Rents have gone up sharply this year.
entries.question: 你覺得台北的物價大幅上漲了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think prices in Taipei have risen sharply?
entries.answer: 對，外食的價錢大幅上漲了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the cost of eating out has gone up a lot.

entries.example: 週末我可以自由安排時間。
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I can plan my time freely.
entries.question: 你覺得在台灣生活自由嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel free living in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 很自由，我想去哪裡就去哪裡。
entries.answerEnglish: Very free. I can go wherever I want.

entries.exampleEnglish: Don't buy things you don't need.
entries.question: 你常買不必要的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often buy unnecessary things?
entries.answer: 常常，我常買不必要的衣服。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I often buy clothes I don't need.

entries.exampleEnglish: His speech was empty of real content.
entries.question: 你覺得廣告的話常常很空洞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think advertising slogans are often hollow?
entries.answer: 對，很多廣告的話都很空洞。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a lot of advertising slogans are empty.

entries.exampleEnglish: Could I borrow a pencil?
entries.question: 你寫中文用鉛筆還是原子筆？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you write Chinese with a pencil or a pen?
entries.answer: 我用鉛筆，寫錯可以擦掉。
entries.answerEnglish: I use a pencil so I can erase mistakes.

entries.exampleEnglish: Teaching children takes a lot of patience.
entries.question: 你是有耐心的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you a patient person?
entries.answer: 還好，但我排隊時沒什麼耐心。
entries.answerEnglish: More or less, but I don't have much patience in lines.

entries.example: 夜市人很多，要小心小偷。
entries.exampleEnglish: The night market is crowded, so watch out for thieves.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過小偷嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever run into a thief in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 沒有，我還沒遇過小偷。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never run into a thief.

entries.example: 跟著地上的箭頭走就到了。
entries.exampleEnglish: Just follow the arrows on the floor and you'll get there.
entries.question: 在捷運站，你會看箭頭找出口嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: At MRT stations, do you follow the arrows to find the exit?
entries.answer: 會，我都跟著箭頭找出口。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always follow the arrows to find the exit.

entries.exampleEnglish: His hobby is photography.
entries.question: 你對攝影有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in photography?
entries.answer: 有，我週末常帶相機去攝影。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often take my camera out to shoot on weekends.

entries.exampleEnglish: This movie is so boring.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼工作很無聊？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of job do you think is boring?
entries.answer: 我覺得一直打字的工作很無聊。
entries.answerEnglish: I think a job where you type all day is boring.

entries.example: 他不幸在車禍中受傷了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was unfortunately injured in a car accident.
entries.question: 你看新聞時，常看到不幸的消息嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often see unfortunate stories in the news?
entries.answer: 常常，新聞裡有很多不幸的消息。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. There are lots of sad stories in the news.

entries.exampleEnglish: If you see anyone suspicious, please call the police.
entries.question: 你在捷運上看過可疑的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen anything suspicious on the MRT?
entries.answer: 沒有，我沒看過可疑的東西。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never seen anything suspicious.

entries.example: 第一次穿西裝，我覺得很彆扭。
entries.exampleEnglish: Wearing a suit for the first time, I felt awkward.
entries.question: 你用中文講電話會覺得彆扭嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel awkward talking on the phone in Chinese?
entries.answer: 會，用中文講電話我覺得很彆扭。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I feel awkward talking on the phone in Chinese.

entries.exampleEnglish: He knows Taiwan's geography well.
entries.question: 你了解台灣的地理嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know much about Taiwan's geography?
entries.answer: 了解一點，但東部的地理我不熟。
entries.answerEnglish: A little, but I don't know the geography of the east coast well.

entries.exampleEnglish: Careful, don't crush the eggs.
entries.question: 買菜時，你怕東西被壓碎嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When buying groceries, do you worry things will get crushed?
entries.answer: 會，我會把雞蛋放上面，免得壓碎。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I put the eggs on top so they don't get crushed.

entries.exampleEnglish: Mosquitoes breed quickly in summer.
entries.question: 你會注意家裡有沒有積水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check for standing water at home?
entries.answer: 會，我常倒掉積水，免得蚊子繁殖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often pour out standing water so mosquitoes can't breed.

entries.example: 台灣的房子通常沒有暖氣。
entries.exampleEnglish: Homes in Taiwan usually don't have heating.
entries.question: 你家冬天會開暖氣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you turn on the heating at home in winter?
entries.answer: 不會，我家沒有暖氣。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my home doesn't have heating.

entries.exampleEnglish: There's a hole in my sock.
entries.question: 你喜歡穿什麼顏色的襪子？
entries.questionEnglish: What color socks do you like to wear?
entries.answer: 我喜歡穿黑色的襪子。
entries.answerEnglish: I like wearing black socks.

entries.example: 這家餐廳的熟成牛排很有名。
entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant's aged steak is famous.
entries.question: 你吃過熟成牛排嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had aged steak?
entries.answer: 吃過，熟成牛排的味道很香。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, aged steak has a really rich flavor.

entries.example: 手機號碼都是零九開頭。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mobile numbers all start with 09.
entries.question: 你的電話號碼有幾個零？
entries.questionEnglish: How many zeros are in your phone number?
entries.answer: 我的電話號碼有兩個零。
entries.answerEnglish: My phone number has two zeros.

entries.exampleEnglish: This sweater is made of wool.
entries.question: 你有羊毛做的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any clothes made of wool?
entries.answer: 有，我有一條羊毛圍巾。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a wool scarf.

entries.example: 這家店的蛋糕很受大家喜愛。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's cakes are loved by everyone.
entries.question: 你最喜愛的台灣小吃是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's your favorite Taiwanese snack?
entries.answer: 我最喜愛的小吃是蚵仔煎。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite snack is oyster omelet.

entries.exampleEnglish: My dog is very loyal to me.
entries.question: 你覺得狗比貓忠心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think dogs are more loyal than cats?
entries.answer: 對，我覺得狗比貓忠心。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think dogs are more loyal than cats.

entries.example: 對動物這麼殘忍，太過分了！
entries.exampleEnglish: Being so cruel to animals is going too far!
entries.question: 你覺得把狗一直關在籠子裡殘忍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think keeping a dog in a cage all the time is cruel?
entries.answer: 很殘忍，狗需要出去散步。
entries.answerEnglish: Very cruel. Dogs need to go out for walks.

entries.example: 有人受傷了，快叫救護車！
entries.exampleEnglish: Someone's hurt. Call an ambulance, quick!
entries.question: 在台灣叫救護車要打幾號？
entries.questionEnglish: What number do you call for an ambulance in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 要打一一九叫救護車。
entries.answerEnglish: You call 119 for an ambulance.

entries.exampleEnglish: The kids are blowing bubbles in the park.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡吹泡泡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like blowing bubbles as a child?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常常在公園吹泡泡。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often blew bubbles in the park.

entries.example: 地上有一根白色的羽毛。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a white feather on the ground.
entries.question: 你喜歡打羽毛球嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like playing badminton?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我每週打一次羽毛球。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I play badminton once a week.

entries.example: 台北的冬天又冷又潮濕。
entries.exampleEnglish: Winter in Taipei is cold and damp.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的天氣潮濕嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find Taiwan's weather humid?
entries.answer: 很潮濕，衣服常常曬不乾。
entries.answerEnglish: Very humid. Laundry often won't dry.

entries.example: 海裡有很多奇怪的生物。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of strange creatures in the sea.
entries.question: 你對生物有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in biology?
entries.answer: 有，我喜歡看海洋生物的影片。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like watching videos about sea life.

entries.exampleEnglish: Chinese grammar isn't very hard.
entries.question: 你覺得中文的文法難嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Chinese grammar is hard?
entries.answer: 不難，中文的文法比英文簡單。
entries.answerEnglish: No, Chinese grammar is simpler than English grammar.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please click this link.
entries.question: 你常點擊網路上的廣告嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often click on ads online?
entries.answer: 不會，我從來不點擊廣告。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I never click on ads.

entries.example: 這間房子的缺點是太小。
entries.exampleEnglish: The drawback of this apartment is that it's too small.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有什麼缺點？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think your shortcomings are?
entries.answer: 我的缺點是常常遲到。
entries.answerEnglish: My weakness is that I'm often late.

entries.exampleEnglish: I was still awake at three in the morning.
entries.question: 你早上幾點醒？
entries.questionEnglish: What time do you wake up in the morning?
entries.answer: 我早上七點就醒了。
entries.answerEnglish: I wake up at seven in the morning.

entries.example: 所有東西都是由原子組成的。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everything is made up of atoms.
entries.question: 你知道原子是什麼嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you know what an atom is?
entries.answer: 知道，原子是非常小的東西。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, an atom is something extremely small.

entries.example: 我發燒了，今天不能上班。
entries.exampleEnglish: I have a fever, so I can't go to work today.
entries.question: 你發燒的時候會去看醫生嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you see a doctor when you have a fever?
entries.answer: 會，發燒的話我會去看醫生。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if I have a fever I go to the doctor.

entries.example: 這位公車駕駛開車很穩。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bus driver drives very smoothly.
entries.question: 你有台灣的駕駛執照嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a Taiwanese driver's license?
entries.answer: 還沒有，我想考台灣的駕駛執照。
entries.answerEnglish: Not yet. I'd like to get a Taiwanese driver's license.

entries.example: 大家都很同情那隻流浪狗。
entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone feels sorry for that stray dog.
entries.question: 你同情路邊的流浪狗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel sorry for the stray dogs on the street?
entries.answer: 很同情，我常餵牠們吃東西。
entries.answerEnglish: I really feel for them. I often feed them.

entries.exampleEnglish: She's very shy and doesn't talk much.
entries.question: 你說中文的時候會害羞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel shy when you speak Chinese?
entries.answer: 一開始會，現在比較不害羞了。
entries.answerEnglish: At first I did, but I'm less shy now.

entries.exampleEnglish: This street runs parallel to the MRT line.
entries.question: 你相信有平行世界嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe in parallel worlds?
entries.answer: 我相信，可能有另一個平行世界。
entries.answerEnglish: I do. There might be another parallel world.

entries.example: 我的手機螢幕有一道刮痕。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a scratch on my phone screen.
entries.question: 你的手機有刮痕嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your phone have any scratches?
entries.answer: 有，螢幕上有幾道刮痕。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are a few scratches on the screen.

entries.exampleEnglish: Could I borrow a ruler?
entries.question: 你工作時需要用尺嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need a ruler for your work?
entries.answer: 需要，我畫圖時要用尺。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I need a ruler when I draw.

entries.exampleEnglish: Keep the receipts from your doctor visits.
entries.question: 你會留著收據嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you keep receipts?
entries.answer: 會，重要的收據我都會留著。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I keep all the important receipts.

entries.exampleEnglish: My cat sheds a lot of fur.
entries.question: 你家的寵物會掉毛嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your pet shed?
entries.answer: 會，我的狗很會掉毛。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my dog sheds a lot.

entries.example: 醫生救活了那隻垂死的小狗。
entries.exampleEnglish: The vet saved the dying puppy.
entries.question: 你救過垂死的小動物嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever saved a dying little animal?
entries.answer: 救過，我救過一隻垂死的小鳥。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once saved a dying little bird.

entries.example: 那隻小狗受到驚嚇，一直發抖。
entries.exampleEnglish: The puppy got a fright and kept trembling.
entries.question: 你看鬼片會受到驚嚇嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get scared watching horror movies?
entries.answer: 會，我看鬼片常常受到驚嚇。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often get scared watching horror movies.

entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a pack of tissues.
entries.question: 你去便利商店常買什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you usually buy at the convenience store?
entries.answer: 我常買一包餅乾。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually buy a packet of cookies.

entries.exampleEnglish: He was absent from the meeting today.
entries.question: 你曾經缺席重要的會議嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever missed an important meeting?
entries.answer: 有一次我生病，缺席了會議。
entries.answerEnglish: Once I was sick and missed a meeting.

entries.exampleEnglish: No cheating at cards!
entries.question: 你玩遊戲時會作弊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cheat when you play games?
entries.answer: 不會，作弊就不好玩了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, cheating takes the fun out of it.

entries.exampleEnglish: Please bring me that book.
entries.question: 你忘了帶鑰匙，會請誰拿來？
entries.questionEnglish: If you forgot your keys, who would you ask to bring them?
entries.answer: 我會請室友拿來給我。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd ask my roommate to bring them to me.

entries.exampleEnglish: That claim is absurd.
entries.question: 你做過什麼荒唐的事？
entries.questionEnglish: What crazy things have you done?
entries.answer: 年輕時我為了一碗麵坐三小時的車，真荒唐。
entries.answerEnglish: When I was young I rode three hours for a bowl of noodles. How absurd!

entries.exampleEnglish: Please give me a spoon.
entries.question: 你喝湯用湯匙還是用碗喝？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you drink soup with a spoon or straight from the bowl?
entries.answer: 我都用湯匙喝湯。
entries.answerEnglish: I always use a spoon for soup.

entries.example: 這雙鞋的鞋底是橡膠做的。
entries.exampleEnglish: The soles of these shoes are made of rubber.
entries.question: 你洗碗時會戴橡膠手套嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you wear rubber gloves when you wash dishes?
entries.answer: 會，我洗碗時都戴橡膠手套。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always wear rubber gloves to wash dishes.

entries.example: 台灣人對外國人很熱情。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwanese people are very warm toward foreigners.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人熱情嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are warm?
entries.answer: 很熱情，常常有人主動幫我。
entries.answerEnglish: Very warm. People often offer to help me.

entries.example: 這張椅子少了一顆螺絲。
entries.exampleEnglish: This chair is missing a screw.
entries.question: 你會自己鎖螺絲組家具嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put furniture together with screws yourself?
entries.answer: 會，我自己鎖螺絲組過書櫃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've screwed together a bookcase myself.

entries.exampleEnglish: Chew your food slowly.
entries.question: 你喜歡嚼口香糖嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like chewing gum?
entries.answer: 喜歡，開車時我常嚼口香糖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often chew gum when I drive.

entries.exampleEnglish: Before the interview, he polished his leather shoes.
entries.question: 你會花時間擦亮你的鞋子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you spend time polishing your shoes?
entries.answer: 會，我每個週末都擦亮皮鞋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I polish my leather shoes every weekend.

entries.exampleEnglish: My grandpa was a sailor when he was young.
entries.question: 你想當水手嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Would you like to be a sailor?
entries.answer: 不想，當水手太辛苦了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, being a sailor is too hard.

entries.exampleEnglish: You should apologize to him.
entries.question: 你上次跟人道歉是什麼時候？
entries.questionEnglish: When did you last apologize to someone?
entries.answer: 昨天我遲到，跟朋友道歉了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yesterday. I was late and apologized to my friend.

entries.example: 我爸爸留了很長的鬍子。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad has grown a long beard.
entries.question: 你喜歡留鬍子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like having a beard?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我每天都刮鬍子。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I shave every day.

entries.exampleEnglish: I look things up in a dictionary on my phone.
entries.question: 你常用什麼字典？
entries.questionEnglish: What dictionary do you usually use?
entries.answer: 我常用手機上的字典。
entries.answerEnglish: I usually use the dictionary on my phone.

entries.example: 這個包包是用竹子編織的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bag is woven from bamboo.
entries.question: 你會編織東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you knit or weave things?
entries.answer: 不會，但我想學編織。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd like to learn to knit.

entries.example: 這位護士照顧病人很盡心。
entries.exampleEnglish: This nurse is devoted to caring for her patients.
entries.question: 你覺得你的中文老師教得盡心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your Chinese teacher puts their heart into teaching?
entries.answer: 很盡心，她每次都準備很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Very much. She prepares a lot every time.

entries.exampleEnglish: My shoelaces are in a knot and I can't undo it.
entries.question: 你的頭髮容易打結嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your hair tangle easily?
entries.answer: 會，我的頭髮很容易打結。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my hair gets knotted easily.

entries.exampleEnglish: The elevator is too crowded, so I'll take the stairs.
entries.question: 你上下班會走樓梯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take the stairs on your way to and from work?
entries.answer: 會，我都走樓梯當運動。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I take the stairs for exercise.

entries.example: 下雨了，不能去海邊，好可惜。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's raining, so we can't go to the beach. What a pity.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼事很可惜？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is a pity?
entries.answer: 沒去看跨年煙火，我覺得很可惜。
entries.answerEnglish: It's a pity I didn't go see the New Year's fireworks.

entries.example: 那家銀行昨天被搶劫了。
entries.exampleEnglish: That bank was robbed yesterday.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的搶劫案多嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think there are many robberies in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 不多，在台灣很少聽到搶劫。
entries.answerEnglish: No, you rarely hear of robberies in Taiwan.

entries.example: 這碗湯裡有紅蘿蔔和玉米。
entries.exampleEnglish: This soup has carrots and corn in it.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃紅蘿蔔嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like carrots?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，我會把紅蘿蔔挑出來。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I pick the carrots out.

entries.exampleEnglish: My ankle has swollen up.
entries.question: 你早上起床眼睛會腫嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are your eyes puffy when you wake up?
entries.answer: 會，晚上喝太多水，眼睛就會腫。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, if I drink too much water at night, my eyes get puffy.

entries.exampleEnglish: He rolled up his sleeves to wash the dishes.
entries.question: 你的頭髮是直的還是捲的？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your hair straight or curly?
entries.answer: 我的頭髮有一點捲。
entries.answerEnglish: My hair is a little curly.

entries.exampleEnglish: How do you pronounce this character?
entries.question: 你會唸你的中文名字嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you say your Chinese name?
entries.answer: 會，我會唸我的中文名字。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I can say my Chinese name.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'd like a piece of cake.
entries.question: 你喝咖啡加幾塊糖？
entries.questionEnglish: How many lumps of sugar do you take in your coffee?
entries.answer: 我加一塊糖就好。
entries.answerEnglish: Just one lump for me.

entries.example: 這把傘太小了，根本沒用。
entries.exampleEnglish: This umbrella is too small; it's useless.
entries.question: 你家有什麼沒用的東西？
entries.questionEnglish: What useless things do you have at home?
entries.answer: 我家有很多沒用的塑膠袋。
entries.answerEnglish: I have lots of useless plastic bags at home.

entries.example: 清明節我們會去祭拜祖先。
entries.exampleEnglish: On Tomb-Sweeping Day we go to pay respects to our ancestors.
entries.question: 你在台灣看過人祭拜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen people make offerings in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 看過，鄰居常在門口祭拜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my neighbors often make offerings at their front door.

entries.example: 下班時間的捷運很擁擠。
entries.exampleEnglish: The MRT is very crowded during rush hour.
entries.question: 你覺得台北哪裡最擁擠？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you think is the most crowded place in Taipei?
entries.answer: 我覺得週末的西門町最擁擠。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Ximending on weekends is the most crowded.

entries.example: 這部電影的結尾很感人。
entries.exampleEnglish: The ending of this movie is very moving.
entries.question: 你喜歡快樂的結尾嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like happy endings?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡故事有快樂的結尾。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like stories to have happy endings.

entries.exampleEnglish: Staying home on a rainy day is so boring.
entries.question: 你無聊的時候會做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you're bored?
entries.answer: 我無聊的時候會滑手機。
entries.answerEnglish: When I'm bored, I scroll on my phone.

entries.example: 我是這家麵店的忠實顧客。
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm a loyal customer of this noodle shop.
entries.question: 你是哪家店的忠實顧客？
entries.questionEnglish: Which shop are you a loyal customer of?
entries.answer: 我是巷口早餐店的忠實顧客。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm a loyal customer of the breakfast shop at the end of my lane.

entries.example: 他說話很間接，我聽不太懂。
entries.exampleEnglish: He speaks so indirectly that I can't quite follow.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人說話比較間接嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people speak more indirectly?
entries.answer: 對，我覺得台灣人說話比較間接。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think Taiwanese people tend to speak indirectly.

entries.exampleEnglish: This child is very polite.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人有禮貌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese people are polite?
entries.answer: 我覺得台灣人很有禮貌。
entries.answerEnglish: I think Taiwanese people are very polite.

entries.example: 我們不應該教小孩仇恨。
entries.exampleEnglish: We shouldn't teach children to hate.
entries.question: 你覺得網路上的仇恨言論多嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think there's a lot of hate speech online?
entries.answer: 很多，網路上常看到仇恨的留言。
entries.answerEnglish: A lot. You often see hateful comments online.

entries.exampleEnglish: You appeared out of nowhere and scared me!
entries.question: 什麼東西最容易嚇到你？
entries.questionEnglish: What scares you most easily?
entries.answer: 蟑螂最容易嚇到我。
entries.answerEnglish: Cockroaches scare me most easily.

entries.example: 聖誕樹上的裝飾品很漂亮。
entries.exampleEnglish: The ornaments on the Christmas tree are beautiful.
entries.question: 你家有什麼裝飾品？
entries.questionEnglish: What decorations do you have at home?
entries.answer: 我家有很多旅行時買的裝飾品。
entries.answerEnglish: I have lots of ornaments I bought while traveling.

entries.exampleEnglish: When driving, you must obey the traffic rules.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣人遵守交通規則嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think people in Taiwan follow the traffic rules?
entries.answer: 大部分的人都會遵守。
entries.answerEnglish: Most people do.

entries.example: 不好意思，我不是故意冒犯你。
entries.exampleEnglish: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.
entries.question: 在台灣，問什麼可能會冒犯別人？
entries.questionEnglish: In Taiwan, what questions might offend people?
entries.answer: 問別人的薪水可能會冒犯人。
entries.answerEnglish: Asking about someone's salary might offend them.

entries.english: be unconscious; be in a coma
entries.exampleEnglish: He was unconscious for three days after the car accident.
entries.question: 如果看到有人昏迷，你會怎麼做？
entries.questionEnglish: If you saw someone unconscious, what would you do?
entries.answer: 看到有人昏迷，我會馬上叫救護車。
entries.answerEnglish: If I saw someone unconscious, I'd call an ambulance right away.

entries.exampleEnglish: It's cold today, so I'm wearing a sweater.
entries.question: 你在台灣冬天需要穿毛衣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need to wear a sweater in Taiwan's winter?
entries.answer: 需要，寒流來的時候要穿毛衣。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when a cold front comes, you need a sweater.

entries.example: 我的鍵盤有一個鍵壞了。
entries.exampleEnglish: One of the keys on my keyboard is broken.
entries.question: 你會用中文鍵盤打字嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you type on a Chinese keyboard?
entries.answer: 會，我用注音鍵盤打字。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I type on a Zhuyin keyboard.

entries.example: 他說謊被發現，覺得很羞愧。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was caught lying and felt ashamed.
entries.question: 你做過什麼讓你羞愧的事？
entries.questionEnglish: What have you done that made you feel ashamed?
entries.answer: 我忘了媽媽的生日，覺得很羞愧。
entries.answerEnglish: I forgot my mom's birthday and felt ashamed.

entries.english: traffic jam; be stuck in traffic
entries.exampleEnglish: There are often traffic jams at rush hour.
entries.question: 你上班的路上會塞車嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you hit traffic on your way to work?
entries.answer: 會，早上常常塞車。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there are often jams in the morning.

entries.exampleEnglish: The printer is out of ink.
entries.question: 你用過鋼筆和墨水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used a fountain pen and ink?
entries.answer: 用過，但墨水常常弄髒手。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but the ink often gets on my hands.

entries.exampleEnglish: The snacks at night markets are very varied.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的食物多樣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwanese food is varied?
entries.answer: 很多樣，每個地方都有特色小吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Very varied. Every place has its own local snacks.

entries.example: 電影裡，他在酒裡放了毒藥。
entries.exampleEnglish: In the movie, he put poison in the wine.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼食物對你像毒藥？
entries.questionEnglish: What food is like poison to you?
entries.answer: 炸雞對我來說就像毒藥。
entries.answerEnglish: Fried chicken is like poison to me.

entries.example: 我們昨天有一點不愉快。
entries.exampleEnglish: We had a bit of a falling-out yesterday.
entries.question: 你在台灣有過不愉快的經驗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you had any unpleasant experiences in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有一次在餐廳有不愉快的經驗。
entries.answerEnglish: I once had an unpleasant experience at a restaurant.

entries.example: 這家餐廳的服務生很親切。
entries.exampleEnglish: The waiters at this restaurant are very friendly.
entries.question: 你當過服務生嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever worked as a waiter?
entries.answer: 當過，我大學時當過服務生。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I was a waiter in college.

entries.exampleEnglish: The dishes are all kept in the cupboard.
entries.question: 你家的碗櫃大嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is the cupboard in your home big?
entries.answer: 不大，我家的碗櫃很小。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my cupboard is very small.

entries.exampleEnglish: Could I borrow a hammer?
entries.question: 你家有鐵鎚嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a hammer at home?
entries.answer: 有，我家有一把小鐵鎚。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a small hammer at home.

entries.example: 外面在下雨，記得帶雨傘。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's raining outside, so remember your umbrella.
entries.question: 你出門都會帶雨傘嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you always take an umbrella when you go out?
entries.answer: 會，我包包裡都有一把雨傘。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always have an umbrella in my bag.

entries.exampleEnglish: There's a spider in the corner.
entries.question: 你怕蜘蛛嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of spiders?
entries.answer: 不怕，蜘蛛會吃蚊子。
entries.answerEnglish: No, spiders eat mosquitoes.

entries.example: 她的新車洗得亮晶晶的。
entries.exampleEnglish: Her new car has been washed until it's sparkling.
entries.question: 你喜歡亮晶晶的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like shiny things?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡亮晶晶的飾品。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like sparkly jewelry.

entries.example: 我的鑰匙掉在沙發底下。
entries.exampleEnglish: My keys fell under the sofa.
entries.question: 你的床底下放了什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you keep under your bed?
entries.answer: 我的床底下放了很多箱子。
entries.answerEnglish: I keep lots of boxes under my bed.

entries.example: 現在很少人用支票付錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: Few people pay by check these days.
entries.question: 你用過支票嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever used a check?
entries.answer: 沒有，我從來沒用過支票。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I've never used a check.

entries.example: 垃圾車來了，快去倒垃圾！
entries.exampleEnglish: The garbage truck is here. Hurry and take out the trash!
entries.question: 你家每天都倒垃圾嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take out the trash every day?
entries.answer: 不是，我家兩天倒一次垃圾。
entries.answerEnglish: No, we take out the trash every two days.

entries.exampleEnglish: Remember to unplug things before you go out.
entries.question: 台灣的插頭和你國家的一樣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are plugs in Taiwan the same as in your country?
entries.answer: 不一樣，我的插頭要用轉接頭。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my plugs need an adapter.

entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a pack of cookies.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃什麼口味的餅乾？
entries.questionEnglish: What flavor of cookies do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡巧克力餅乾。
entries.answerEnglish: I like chocolate cookies.

entries.exampleEnglish: You must take your passport when you go abroad.
entries.question: 你的護照什麼時候到期？
entries.questionEnglish: When does your passport expire?
entries.answer: 我的護照明年到期。
entries.answerEnglish: My passport expires next year.

entries.exampleEnglish: Lots of shrubs have been planted in the park.
entries.question: 你家附近有灌木嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any bushes near your home?
entries.answer: 有，路邊種了很多灌木。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lots of bushes are planted along the road.

entries.exampleEnglish: I don't like bitter melon.
entries.question: 你不喜歡吃什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What food don't you like?
entries.answer: 我不喜歡吃臭豆腐。
entries.answerEnglish: I don't like stinky tofu.

entries.exampleEnglish: This restaurant is too noisy.
entries.question: 你家附近吵不吵？
entries.questionEnglish: Is it noisy around your home?
entries.answer: 很吵，樓下有很多機車。
entries.answerEnglish: Very noisy. There are lots of scooters downstairs.

entries.exampleEnglish: He's unwilling to work overtime.
entries.question: 你願意週末加班嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you willing to work overtime on weekends?
entries.answer: 我不願意週末加班。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm not willing to work overtime on weekends.

entries.exampleEnglish: This winter is unusually warm.
entries.question: 你覺得今年的天氣異常嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think this year's weather is unusual?
entries.answer: 很異常，十一月還這麼熱。
entries.answerEnglish: Very unusual. It's still this hot in November.

entries.exampleEnglish: Gas prices have gone up again recently.
entries.question: 你多久加一次汽油？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you fill up with gas?
entries.answer: 我一個禮拜加一次汽油。
entries.answerEnglish: I fill up once a week.

entries.exampleEnglish: My suitcase is too heavy.
entries.question: 你旅行時帶大的行李箱嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you take a big suitcase when you travel?
entries.answer: 不，我只帶一個小行李箱。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I just take a small suitcase.

entries.exampleEnglish: He's jealous that his coworker got promoted.
entries.question: 你會嫉妒別人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you ever get jealous of others?
entries.answer: 有時候會嫉妒中文很好的朋友。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes I'm jealous of friends whose Chinese is really good.

entries.exampleEnglish: Smoking is harmful to your health.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼對身體有害？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think is harmful to your health?
entries.answer: 我覺得熬夜對身體有害。
entries.answerEnglish: I think staying up late is harmful to your health.

entries.example: 她個性很開朗，朋友很多。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very cheerful and has lots of friends.
entries.question: 你覺得自己個性開朗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you have a cheerful personality?
entries.answer: 對，我覺得我很開朗。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think I'm very cheerful.

entries.example: 明天要去旅行，我好興奮！
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going on a trip tomorrow. I'm so excited!
entries.question: 什麼事讓你最興奮？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you most excited?
entries.answer: 出國旅行讓我最興奮。
entries.answerEnglish: Traveling abroad excites me the most.

entries.exampleEnglish: The fire brigade quickly arrived at the scene.
entries.question: 你回訊息很迅速嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you reply to messages quickly?
entries.answer: 工作的訊息我都迅速回覆。
entries.answerEnglish: I always reply promptly to work messages.

entries.example: 下雨天我們在室內運動。
entries.exampleEnglish: On rainy days we exercise indoors.
entries.question: 下雨天你喜歡什麼室內活動？
entries.questionEnglish: What indoor activities do you like on rainy days?
entries.answer: 我喜歡去咖啡店，在室內看書。
entries.answerEnglish: I like going to a café and reading indoors.

entries.exampleEnglish: These tablets should be taken after meals.
entries.question: 你吃藥片需要配很多水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need a lot of water to take tablets?
entries.answer: 對，我吃藥片要配很多水。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I need lots of water to take tablets.

entries.exampleEnglish: This lemon is so sour!
entries.question: 你喜歡吃酸的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like sour food?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡吃酸的水果。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like sour fruit.

entries.example: 廣告常常誇大產品的效果。
entries.exampleEnglish: Ads often exaggerate what products can do.
entries.question: 你覺得網路新聞常誇大嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think online news often exaggerates?
entries.answer: 對，很多網路新聞都太誇大了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a lot of online news is too exaggerated.

entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the dentist tomorrow.
entries.question: 你多久看一次牙醫？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you go to the dentist?
entries.answer: 我半年看一次牙醫。
entries.answerEnglish: I go to the dentist every six months.

entries.example: 在捷運上大聲講電話很沒禮貌。
entries.exampleEnglish: Talking loudly on the phone on the MRT is rude.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼行為很沒禮貌？
entries.questionEnglish: What behavior do you think is rude?
entries.answer: 我覺得插隊很沒禮貌。
entries.answerEnglish: I think cutting in line is rude.

entries.exampleEnglish: Wide-leg pants are in style this year.
entries.question: 現在台灣流行什麼飲料？
entries.questionEnglish: What drinks are popular in Taiwan right now?
entries.answer: 現在很流行喝手搖飲。
entries.answerEnglish: Hand-shaken drinks are really popular now.

entries.exampleEnglish: Everyone, please take a step back.
entries.question: 你的辦公椅可以向後躺嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can your office chair recline?
entries.answer: 可以，我的辦公椅可以向後躺。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my office chair can lean back.

entries.exampleEnglish: This candy is so sticky.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃黏的食物嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like sticky food?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我喜歡吃黏黏的麻糬。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like chewy, sticky mochi.

entries.exampleEnglish: My hobby is hiking.
entries.question: 你有什麼嗜好？
entries.questionEnglish: What hobbies do you have?
entries.answer: 我的嗜好是拍照。
entries.answerEnglish: My hobby is taking photos.
